FIELDS.NAME: Springfield Family Medical and Dental Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Springfield Family Medical and Dental Center, we operate as a comprehensive healthcare provider, delivering both medical and dental services to our community. Our team consists of licensed healthcare professionals who are dedicated to ensuring patient health and safety while maintaining compliance with all state and federal regulations. We prioritize patient care through structured appointment scheduling and thorough patient intake processes, which help minimize operational errors. Our facility is equipped with appropriate safety protocols and documented employee training regarding hazardous material handling and emergency procedures. We securely store patient records and adhere to data privacy regulations to protect sensitive information. With a robust risk management protocol in place, our practice regularly conducts risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards. Our commitment to quality care and patient safety is reflected in our clean claims history and readiness to address any past issues promptly.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that we maintain current state and federal licenses for all practicing healthcare professionals. We have documented employee training on hazardous material handling and emergency procedures, and ensure that all hazardous and flammable materials are stored in compliance with OSHA and local fire safety regulations. Additionally, our ventilation systems are designed to be adequate for the safe storage and use of disinfectants, anesthetics, and sterilizing agents.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a water leak from the ceiling caused damage to several medical and dental records and equipment, resulting in a total loss of $2,500. The incident has been resolved, and all affected equipment has been replaced or repaired. The status is closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, Fire-Resistant Safe with Electronic Lock
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security alarm system installation with 24/7 monitoring and regular safety drills for staff.
